'''Brian Van Ginsberg''' is a minor character in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Background===
Van Ginsberg is mentioned on the [[Epsilon Program (3D Universe)|Epsilon Program]] website.<ref>[http://www.rockstargames.com/epsilonprogram/testimonials.htm Epsilon Program Testimonials Page]</ref>

Ginsberg is a resident of [[Carcer City (3D Universe)|Carcer City]], who turned to the Epsilon Program to help him. He states that: "''[[Religion]] never worked for me, until now!''"
